front_blocks.md: Define **hardware**.

back_blocks.md: Hardware is the **physical components** of a computer system.

cards.front_md: Define **hardware**.

front_blocks.md: Name the three categories of hardware.

back_blocks.md: The three categories of hardware are **internal components**, **internal memory** and **hardware components**.

cards.front_md: Name the three categories of hardware.
cards.back_md: The three categories of hardware are **internal components**, **internal memory** and **hardware components**.

front_blocks.md: What is the role of the motherboard?

back_blocks.md: The motherboard **connects all the important components together**, allowing them to communicate.

front_blocks.md: Define **processor**.

back_blocks.md: A processor is an **electronic circuit that processes information**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
RAM and ROM are classed as internal memory.

back_blocks.md: **True.**

front_blocks.md: What does a graphics card do?

back_blocks.md: A graphics card (**GPU**) **processes images and video**.

front_blocks.md: What does a sound card do?

front_blocks.md: What is the purpose of an input device?

back_blocks.md: An input device **allows user input**, for example a mouse or a keyboard.

front_blocks.md: What is the purpose of an output device?

back_blocks.md: An output device **outputs the results of processing**, for example a monitor.

front_blocks.md: Define **software**.

back_blocks.md: Software is the set of programs that **control the hardware**; it lives on the computer system but **cannot be physically touched**.

cards.front_md: Define **software**.
cards.back_md: Software is the set of programs that **control the hardware**; it lives on the computer system but **cannot be physically touched**.

front_blocks.md: What are the two categories of software?

back_blocks.md: The two categories of software are **application** software and **system** software.

cards.front_md: What are the two categories of software?
cards.back_md: The two categories of software are **application** software and **system** software.

front_blocks.md: Define **application software**.

back_blocks.md: Application software is software **chosen by a user** to help them carry out a **specific task**.

cards.front_md: Define **application software**.
cards.back_md: Application software is software **chosen by a user** to help them carry out a **specific task**.

front_blocks.md: Define **system software**.

back_blocks.md: System software is software that is **essential for the operation of a computer system**.

cards.front_md: Define **system software**.
cards.back_md: System software is software that is **essential for the operation of a computer system**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Control software is system software.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Control software is **application** software, even though it controls a system.

**True or False?**

Control software is system software.

**False.**

Control software is **application** software, even though it controls a system.

front_blocks.md: What does a compiler do, and which category of software is it?

back_blocks.md: A compiler is **system** software that **translates high-level programming languages into machine code**.

cards.front_md: What does a compiler do, and which category of software is it?
cards.back_md: A compiler is **system** software that **translates high-level programming languages into machine code**.

front_blocks.md: What does a device driver do?

back_blocks.md: A device driver is **system** software that **controls hardware components and peripherals**.

cards.front_md: What does a device driver do?
cards.back_md: A device driver is **system** software that **controls hardware components and peripherals**.

front_blocks.md: Give three examples of application software.

back_blocks.md: Application software includes **word processing**, **spreadsheet**, **database management systems**, **control/measurement**, **video editing**, **graphics editing**, **audio editing** and **computer-aided design (CAD)**.

cards.front_md: Give three examples of application software.

front_blocks.md: Define **operating system**.

back_blocks.md: An operating system is software that provides an **interface between the user and the hardware** in a computer system.

cards.front_md: Define **operating system**.
cards.back_md: An operating system is software that provides an **interface between the user and the hardware** in a computer system.

front_blocks.md: Give three things an operating system does.

back_blocks.md: An operating system **controls input/output devices**, **oversees the loading, running and storage of application software**, **deals with errors**, **maintains security** and **keeps a log of events**.

cards.front_md: Give three things an operating system does.
cards.back_md: An operating system **controls input/output devices**, **oversees the loading, running and storage of application software**, **deals with errors**, **maintains security** and **keeps a log of events**.

front_blocks.md: Name the four types of user interface.

back_blocks.md: The four types of user interface are **command line (CLI)**, **graphical (GUI)**, **dialogue-based** and **gesture-based**.

front_blocks.md: Define **analogue data**.

back_blocks.md: Analogue data is **continuous data** created from non-digital devices, which changes **gradually and smoothly**.

cards.front_md: Define **analogue data**.
cards.back_md: Analogue data is **continuous data** created from non-digital devices, which changes **gradually and smoothly**.

front_blocks.md: Define **digital data**.

back_blocks.md: Digital data is data represented in a **binary format** (1s and 0s), created and stored using digital devices.

cards.front_md: Define **digital data**.
cards.back_md: Digital data is data represented in a **binary format** (1s and 0s), created and stored using digital devices.

front_blocks.md: Give two examples of analogue data.

back_blocks.md: Examples of analogue data are the **sound waves** produced when you talk, and data collected by **sensors**.

front_blocks.md: Give two examples of digital data.

back_blocks.md: Examples of digital data are **software** and **documents or files**.

Digital data loses quality during storage and transmission.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Digital data **maintains its quality** during storage and transmission. It is **analogue** data whose quality can be lost.

front_blocks.md: Define **analogue to digital conversion (ADC)**.

back_blocks.md: ADC is the process of taking **samples** of an analogue signal and **converting them to a binary code**.

cards.front_md: Define **analogue to digital conversion (ADC)**.
cards.back_md: ADC is the process of taking **samples** of an analogue signal and **converting them to a binary code**.

front_blocks.md: Why must analogue data be converted to digital data?

back_blocks.md: Analogue data must be converted to digital data so that it **can be processed by a computer**.
